author: PokerFace
body:
Hello everybody!
Recently, I have noticed that games like Avicade aren't played much. What I suggest is that at different times throughout the day, we close one gamemode for an hour to encourage playing elsewhere. Perhaps if we do this for a week, naturally players would be spread out in terms of games instead of all compacted into nebula. 

Comment below on suggestions. Thanks!

Off note: I have been part of Avicus for a while and, I have never got to play the newest additions to Avicade ever.
